chunks: Do not place women on saddles, lest you provoke them toward immorality.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.الْفُرُوجَ: women, as referred to in this wording
key_terms.فَتُهَيِّجُوهُنَّ: thus you may arouse or stir them

ai.seo_question: What did Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام say about placing women on saddles?
ai.summary: This saying from Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام gives an ethical warning against conduct that may stir temptation and lead to immoral behavior. It reflects a concern for safeguarding modesty and preventing avenues that may lead to indecency.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4626 - Commander of the Faithful (as) said:
"Do not place women on saddles, for it may provoke them toward immorality."
